title: The Cursed Pumpkin
summary: Stealth-resource hot-potato game with sealed guesses and an epoch-timed holder reveal. On November 12, Veil showed the mainnet template publish committed at 05:38:14 UTC and its game creation committed at 06:35:02 UTC, both with network byte 0. The receipt matches template dc7d2ed8…abe56b44 and official game component f0a10a09…988357a2. The mainnet game requires a 1 TARI bond; losing guesses or a holder who fails to reveal can forfeit some or all of that bond. The creator’s current README and extracted public page distinguish a mainnet board from the recorded November 7 Esmeralda game; the Python client remains testnet-only. Timing, pass counts, off-chain information and the final holder remain observable. The new recording is a November 12 README walkthrough, not a live game or wallet session. Earlier October 28 replay footage and the November 4 failed-component observation remain in the maintenance history, superseded by these new deployment receipts. MIT source; template library 0.38. No wallets, transactions or third-party code were used in this review.
cardSummary: Follow a stealth hot-potato game with sealed guesses, epoch-timed reveals and bonds shared among successful guessers.
